title: Rabbi Abba, Brother of Rabbi Yehudah bar Zevadi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yevamot 83b has Rav Shmuel bar Yehudah reporting Rabbi Abba, brother of Zevadi, in Rav Yehudah’s name in Rav’s name. Tosafot on 83a, under Rabbi Yose, reads that he spoke in Rav Huna’s name. They are right: Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5, 12b, has Rav Huna instructing Rabbi Yehudah bar Zevadi’s brother. It is very unlikely that he is Rabbi Abba bar Zevada: a scholar well known throughout the Talmud would not be identified through a brother mentioned only rarely.

notes.text: The heading calls Abba the brother of Yehudah bar Zevadi; the abbreviated quoted chain says brother of Zevadi. Hyman’s argument against identifying him as Abba bar Zevada is retained.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud names the brother of Yehudah bar Zevadi as Rav Huna’s addressee. The exact Tosafot reading and Hyman’s argument that this is very unlikely to be Abba bar Zevada remain attributed, without identity admission.
